title: Appointment Booking, Rescheduling & Cancellation Policy
content: Appointments can be booked up to 30 days in advance via website or AI Voice agent. Free cancellation or rescheduling is permitted up to 2 hours prior to the slot time. Late arrivals beyond 15 minutes may require rescheduling to avoid delay for other patients.

title: Accepted Health Insurance & Cashless Billing Process
content: We accept major health insurance providers including Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Niva Bupa, Care Health, and Max Bupa. Cashless claims are processed at the reception desk upon producing a valid Government photo ID and active policy card.

title: Pre-Appointment & Lab Fasting Guidelines
content: For General Health Checkups, Blood Glucose (Fasting), and Lipid Profile tests, patients must fast for 8 to 10 hours prior to sample collection. Water is permitted. Please bring past medical records, prescriptions, government ID, and insurance cards.

title: AI Voice Calling Agent & Teleconsultation Services
content: Patients can place direct AI voice calls or request automated phone calls via OmniDim Agent (+918591556205) to check availability, confirm appointments, or speak with an AI assistant. Digitally signed prescriptions are sent instantly via WhatsApp and Email.

title: Emergency Response & 24/7 Trauma Services
content: For medical emergencies, severe chest pain, or trauma, contact our 24/7 Emergency Line immediately at +918591556205 or visit the Emergency Ward entrance. Our AI triage system instantly notifies on-duty emergency physicians.

title: Accepted Payment Methods & Refund Processing
content: We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Debit & Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), and Net Banking. In case of cancellation, eligible refunds are automatically processed back to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.

title: Diagnostic Lab Reports & Home Sample Collection
content: Diagnostic lab test results are published online on the patient dashboard within 6 to 12 hours. Senior citizens and mobility-impaired patients can request free Home Sample Collection by selecting the option during booking.
